title: Bioanalytical Laboratory
objective: Complete bioanalytical testing workflow from sample reception to archiving
content: Bioanalytical Laboratory notebook template with 5 predefined workflow pages for sample reception, test assignment, analytical execution, reporting, and storage/archiving.

pages.title: Sample Reception & Registration
pages.instructions: Register sample receipt: Assign or retain Sample ID, capture sample type (API, tablet, plasma, serum, etc.), note source (Medical Lab or external client), record requested tests, document storage condition on arrival, receipt date/time, and receiving personnel.
pages.content: Sample Reception & Registration - Batch verification and metadata capture of incoming samples

manifestColumns.label: Unique Sample ID
manifestColumns.description: Unique identifier assigned to each sample submitted for bioanalytical testing.

manifestColumns.label: Sample Type
manifestColumns.description: Type of sample matrix (e.g., plasma, serum, API, tablet formulation).

manifestColumns.label: Date/Time of Receipt
manifestColumns.description: Date and time the sample was received at the bioanalytical laboratory.

manifestColumns.label: Source/Origin
manifestColumns.description: Institution, clinic, or department from which the sample was submitted.

manifestColumns.label: Requested Tests
manifestColumns.description: Analytical tests requested for this sample (e.g., LC-MS/MS drug quantification).

manifestColumns.label: Receiving Personnel
manifestColumns.description: Name or staff ID of the analyst who received and registered this sample.

manifestColumns.label: Project/Study
manifestColumns.description: Research study or protocol this sample is linked to.

manifestColumns.label: Storage Condition Prior
manifestColumns.description: Storage conditions maintained before the sample was shipped to this laboratory.

manifestColumns.label: Sample Volume/Quantity
manifestColumns.description: Volume or quantity of the sample with units.

manifestColumns.label: Manifest Verification Status
manifestColumns.description: Status of manifest verification at time of receipt.

manifestColumns.label: Timepoint
manifestColumns.description: Study timepoint at which this sample was collected (e.g., pre-dose, 2h, 24h).

manifestColumns.label: Subject ID
manifestColumns.description: De-identified identifier of the study subject or volunteer who provided this sample.

manifestColumns.label: Notes
manifestColumns.description: Any special handling instructions or observations about this sample.

pages.title: Test Assignment & Preparation
pages.instructions: Assign tests to analysts/pharmacists by test category. Select analytical method (HPLC UV-Vis, LC-MS/MS, dissolution apparatus, etc.) from dropdown. Specify instrument ID, calibration status. Document sample preparation methodology. Define QC requirements (calibration curve criteria, control samples). Set expected analysis date.
pages.content: Test Assignment & Preparation - Methodology selection and analyst assignment

pages.title: Analytical Test Execution
pages.instructions: Record execution date/time and analyst ID. Upload or link calibration curve details (r-squared value, slope, intercept, acceptance criteria). Document QC sample results (Low/Medium/High concentrations) with acceptance limits. Upload raw data files (chromatograms, spectra). Record calculated results with units. Document any deviations. Verify ALCOA+ compliance (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, Complete).
pages.content: Analytical Test Execution - Raw data capture and QC validation

pages.title: Reporting & Release
pages.instructions: Compile all sample results. Validate against acceptance criteria. Perform Primary Review (analyst validation). Perform Secondary Review (senior scientist/QA). Obtain Final Approval (lab manager/study director). Select result distribution method (email, REDCap, LMIS integration, manual). Generate performance metrics dashboard. Document data integrity and audit trail.
pages.content: Reporting & Release - Result compilation, validation, and report generation with embedded dashboard

pages.title: Post-Test Storage & Archiving
pages.instructions: Document quantity retained for storage. Transfer to biorepository if applicable. Record exact storage location and set retention period.
pages.content: Post-Test Storage & Archiving - Storage tracking, retention periods, and data archiving
